dog.description_text: Meet Big Boy — New Arrival! Big Boy just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about his time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/GRP_NYC_Foster/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral%2FBig%20Boy%20%2D%20About%20Me%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral&p=true&share=cQoSmiRAUTttTp0mXNu8gPIZEgUCxfJsC%5Fh8Ri%5FyIPhbV85J%5Fg His foster says "Big Boy has been very curious from the start, exploring our space as soon as he came out of his carrier. For the first couple days his chosen spots were behind or under furniture where he could keep an eye on things, and every so often he would hop up and headbutt us and ask for pets before taking a turn around the apartment and going back to his spot. He still loves to explore but within a few days he has also become very comfortable flopping over out in the open or curling up for a nap beside us. We just love how sweet he is! When he purrs he makes a cooing sound like a pigeon, which is super cute.". He is gentle, playful, and affectionate. He is neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure he is ready for his next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
